1. This Statement of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 has been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard (referred to as "Ind AS") 34 - Interim Financial Reporting prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India, read with the relevant rules issued thereunder, as amended from time to time and in terms of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended ("Listing Regulations 2015"). These results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meetings held on November 12, 2026.

2. The equity shares of the Company were listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) on August 25, 2026. Accordingly, these are the second quarterly results of the Company after the listing of its equity shares. The statutory auditors of the Company have carried out a limited review of the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 were also subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors. The figures for the half year ended September 30, 2025 and the year ended March 31, 2026 have been audited by the statutory auditors. The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 are the balancing figures between the audited figures for the half year ended September 30, 2025 and the unaudited figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. The figures for the quarters ended June 30, 2025 and September 30, 2025 have not been subjected to audit or limited review by the statutory auditors; however, the management has exercised necessary due diligence to ensure that these financial results provide a true and fair view of the Company's affairs.

4. The aggregate of Other income for the quarters ended June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2026 (Rs. 113.82 lakhs) does not tally with the Other income reported for the half year ended September 30, 2026 (Rs. 113.19 lakhs). This is primarily on account of foreign exchange fluctuation, which resulted in a net loss of Rs. 0.63 lakhs for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (presented under Other expenses) and a net gain of Rs. 16.86 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (presented under Other income). For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net foreign exchange gain of Rs. 16.23 lakhs has been presented under Other income. Consequently, Other expenses for the half year (Rs. 72.23 lakhs) are also lower than the aggregate of the two quarters (Rs. 72.86 lakhs).
5. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company completed its Initial Public Offer (“IPO”) of equity shares of face value of Rs.10 each at an issue price of Rs.360 per equity share, including a share premium of Rs.350 per equity share. The IPO comprised a fresh issue of 48,00,034 equity shares aggregating to Rs.17,280.12 lakhs and an offer for sale of 30,37,157 equity shares by the selling shareholders aggregating to Rs.10,933.77 lakhs.

6. Pursuant to the IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (“NSE”) and BSE Limited (“BSE”) on August 25, 2026.

7. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company paid GST of Rs. 1.44 crore on Offer for Sale expenses out of the IPO proceeds allocated to “Funding the working capital requirements of the Company”. The management has considered this a deviation, as it is not covered within the stated object.

8. Earnings per share for the quarters ended September 30, 2026, June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 and for the half years ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 are not annualised.
9. The Company operates in the business of film production, distribution, and media content creation. Revenue in this segment is recognized at a specific point in time upon the theatrical release of motion pictures or completion of content delivery licenses. Because the release calendar fluctuates based on production schedules and theatrical window availability, the financial performance is inherently non-linear. Accordingly, the financial results for the quarter ended are not comparable quarter-on-quarter or year-on-year with previous periods.
10. The Company operates in a single business segment within the meaning of Ind AS 108, "Operating Segments", and accordingly, segment information is not applicable
11. The aforesaid financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 have been filed with BSE and NSE and are also available on Company's website "https://sunshinepictures.in".
12. Figures for the previous period/ year have been regrouped/ reclassified wherever necessary to conform to the current period's classification. The impact of such regrouping/reclassification is not material to the financial results.
